label: sec:su2-so3
html: The groups \mathrm{SU}(2) and \mathrm{SO}(3) serve as the natural gauge groups on the substrate and archimedean sides, respectively. We fix their bases, clarify the first-order Taylor relation between their generators, and establish the quaternionic picture of \mathrm{SO}(3) necessary for identifying \mathrm{SU}_q(2) as the substrate deformation of \mathrm{SU}(2).
